title: Library Laptop Loans
transcript: Hello, library visitors. Starting Monday, the library will lend laptops at the front desk. You can borrow one for up to four hours with your student card. Since we only have thirty machines, we recommend reserving one online, especially during exam weeks. Please return laptops to the desk, not the book drop, because the drop isn't padded and they can easily be damaged. Late returns will lose borrowing privileges for one week.
